Since all empty accounts are gone outside of the test suite I think we should stop writing tests about them. I've thrown together [a hackmd](https://notes.ethereum.org/@RG8j1GXNQ-iPkkFqXEouVA/By-ep0ry6) with a proposal to do that.

Hopefully we can resolve the `0xff..fe` issue (and similar future issues) that way.

General updates from the testing team we wanted to share in the meeting:
- Execution Spec Tests
  - 1153 tests merged to main: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/pull/230, https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/pull/292, https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/pull/299
  - 4788 PR to update to latest version: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/pull/297
    - The deploy tx is missing from the latest EIP PR, we are only waiting on this to merge and release
  - EIP-7516 tests: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-spec-tests/pull/294
    - will be merged soon and included in next release
- Hive
  - Geth London non-zero-block-number issue test case: https://github.com/ethereum/hive/pull/867
  - Mock builder is Deneb-ready: https://github.com/marioevz/mock-builder/releases/tag/v1.1.0
  - Builder tests can be run using: https://github.com/ethereum/hive/pull/838
